# Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R

Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R is a regional function within the Danish child and adolescent psychiatric system, listed in the ADHD-databasen quality registry for the reporting period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src1] [^src2]. It appears in the database's tables of quality-indicator results, which track how well psychiatric units across Denmark's regions implement standardized parts of the ADHD assessment process, such as diagnostic interviews, environmental (miljø) observations, and diagnostic conferences with specialists [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

The unit's most notable documented result is a 100 % fulfilment rate on indicator 2b, which measures the frequency of manualized diagnostic interviews or environmental observation in ADHD assessments of children and young people [^src1]. This is recorded as meeting the development target set for the indicator, which nationally stood at 90 % [^src1]. In the same source material, however, a separate table entry for Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R shows a very different figure — "Nej #/# 0 (0-84)" — suggesting that for another metric in the dataset the unit registered 0 % with a "Nej" (No) mark, in contrast to its 100 % score elsewhere [^src4]. The data provided does not explain the discrepancy between these two entries, and no further narrative detail is given to reconcile them.

Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R also appears, without additional context, in a later section of the same document that lists steering-group members and appendices on ADHD case-load demographics for the same reporting period [^src5]. This placement situates the unit within the broader ADHD-databasen reporting structure, alongside discussion of regional variation in indicator performance — for example, other units such as Vejle and Aabenraa achieved 100 % on indicator 2a, while Region Sjælland and Region Nordjylland fell well short of the 90 % target, and the database as a whole showed only 51 % and 27 % national fulfilment on indicators 2b and 3 respectively, with Region Midtjylland improving and Region Syddanmark trending downward [^src1] [^src2]. No relationships between Børne-Unge Psyk. Reg.fkt. 40.R and other named entities are documented in the available material.
